entries.title: Closing a task carried on by another no longer brings back an old card
entries.body: When your first mate closed a task as carried on by another task, an answer you had already accepted could come back with a weeks-old line saying some other task was dropped. That old line no longer appears, and the card stays where you left it.
entries.noPicture: The fix stops an old card from coming back; nothing new appears on screen.
